verdict.rationale: Tailscale directly documents infrastructure access to resources wherever they live, including Kubernetes clusters, plus auditable access to SSH, K8s, and databases across clouds and on-prem, with subnet routers and a Kubernetes sidecar deployment guide. Community users independently confirm the Kubernetes operator works well and describe secure dev, staging, and prod access without public exposure. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Kubernetes operator or cluster API access in the evidence pack (it appears only as a community mention and marketing copy).
